name: Low-level requirements review
description: Reviews low-level requirements for deterministic, implementable, traceable, and verifiable design detail.

prompt.reviewer_role: Act as an independent low-level software requirements and design reviewer.
prompt.objective: Assess whether the LLR set defines deterministic and implementable behaviour that completely refines the HLR while remaining objectively verifiable.
instructions: Execute every review section completely and with equal diligence; implementation context may add constraints but cannot remove checks.
Check algorithms, states, dataflow, interfaces, boundaries, timing, initialization, resource constraints, and defensive behaviour.
Compare interface claims with supplied interface definitions before reporting a defect.

review_sections.title: Scope, source and applicable obligations
review_sections.instruction: Review scope, assumptions, assurance allocation, parent HLRs, architecture constraints, and consistency with every supplied plan, standard, requirement, and instruction.

review_sections.title: Individual requirement quality
review_sections.instruction: Review every LLR for correctness, necessity, atomicity, clarity, completeness, consistency, deterministic meaning, feasible implementation, and objective verifiability.

review_sections.title: Deterministic behaviour and algorithms
review_sections.instruction: Review algorithms, calculations, sequencing, preconditions, outputs, limits, precision, overflow, underflow, rounding, boundary conditions, and implementation completeness.

review_sections.title: Dataflow and interfaces
review_sections.instruction: Review types, units, ranges, scaling, validity, initialization, freshness, conversions, and interface failure behaviour.

review_sections.title: State and timing
review_sections.instruction: Review states, transitions, event priority, timers, scheduling assumptions, boundary semantics, and recovery.

review_sections.title: Defensive behaviour, safety and resources
review_sections.instruction: Review invalid inputs, corrupt states, failures, degraded modes, recovery, safe defaults, safety mechanisms, concurrency, memory, stack, execution time, and deterministic resource use.

review_sections.title: Set completeness and internal consistency
review_sections.instruction: Review the complete LLR set for missing cases, duplication, conflicts, unreachable behaviour, incomplete mode coverage, incompatible assumptions, and consistency with architecture and interfaces.

review_sections.title: Traceability and verification
review_sections.instruction: Review complete HLR allocation, bidirectional links, derived content, orphan content, measurable acceptance criteria, planned methods, normal, boundary and robustness coverage, and missing evidence.

review_sections.title: Lifecycle and presentation control
review_sections.instruction: Review naming, decomposition, identifiers, ownership, status, baselines, changes, approvals, anomalies, cross-references, readability, spelling, grammar, and controlled use.

options.label: Mixed
options.prompt_value: a mixed model-based and hand-written implementation

inputs.label: Implementation constraints
inputs.help: Optional language, platform, modelling, or resource constraints.
inputs.placeholder: Language subset, target processor, cycle time, memory limits...
inputs.prompt_template: Judge the requirements against these implementation constraints: {value}.
